decisions.reason: The in-ear earmold builds on the firm's core hearing-care earmold competence and certified digital production, so its incremental cost is low, and in a growing industry with available slack there is no visible shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.

The individual EARsleeve has its own page and is promoted for universal in-ear systems, which signals commitment and a fit with the firm's earmold expertise, so it likely meets aspirations and stays on the market.

The orthopedic shoe last is distant from the core business and its results are still uncertain, but it was only launched in 2024 and has its own page, and slack in a growing industry lets the firm carry this exploratory use of its digital manufacturing know-how a while longer.

The post-curing unit complements the firm's 3D-printing and materials workflow and supports its integrated-system strategy, so it is likely retained even with modest early visibility, although the earlier withdrawal of the thermoforming unit shows equipment is pruned when it underperforms.
